_comment: AR Gallery model list. Each item needs a name, an optional thumbnail URL, and a DIRECT GLB url (not a web page, not USDZ). Keep models small & low-poly (a few MB) so they download fast and run cool on the X3 Pro's AR1 chip. All entries below should be CC0 / freely-licensed — verify the license before adding your own.
_free_glb_sources: Khronos glTF Sample Assets (CC0/permissive): github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets — raw GLB URLs
Poly Pizza (CC0/CC-BY low-poly, kid-friendly): poly.pizza — use the GLB download link
Sketchfab downloadable free models (check each license; export GLB)
USDZ-only model? Convert once on a computer (Apple Reality Converter / Blender glTF export / usd2gltf) and host the GLB.
_note: The URLs below are EXAMPLES pointing at the public Khronos CC0 sample set so the app works out of the box. Replace/extend with your daughter's favorites. Direct-GLB only.
